_comment: Hand-picked Gradio-powered repos. Every entry here is verified to (a) exist on GitHub, (b) ship an `app.py` (or equivalent) that Gradio can deploy. The directory is seeded from this file on first load. New tools submitted via 'Submit a tool' get queued in data/submissions.json and can be reviewed/merged here.

tools.name: Whisper
tools.description: OpenAI's robust speech recognition model. Multilingual transcription and translation, runs on CPU or GPU. Ships with a Gradio demo.
tools.notes: One of the most-deployed Gradio Spaces on HF. CPU is fine for short clips; GPU recommended for long audio.

tools.name: AudioCraft
tools.description: Meta's framework for audio generation. Includes MusicGen (text-to-music), AudioGen (text-to-sound), and EnCodec (neural codec).
tools.notes: MusicGen Large needs an A10G or better for real-time generation. Small/Medium work on T4. Public HF demo has been retired — deploy your own with the command above.

tools.name: XTTS v2 (in Coqui TTS)
tools.description: Voice cloning and multilingual TTS. Clone a voice from a 6-second sample, then speak in 17 languages. Streaming inference. XTTS v2 lives in the Coqui TTS monorepo.
tools.notes: GPU strongly recommended (T4 minimum). Use --app-file TTS/server/server.py in the deploy command. License restricts commercial use. Public demo may be sleeping; deploy your own for instant response.

tools.name: Stable Video Diffusion (via generative-models)
tools.description: Image-to-video generation from Stability AI. Generate 14-25 frame video clips from a single starting frame. SVD ships inside the generative-models monorepo alongside Stable Diffusion XL.
tools.notes: Needs an A10G (24GB VRAM) at minimum. The SVD-XT 1.1 weights are gated — request access on HF before deploying.

tools.name: Bark
tools.description: Transformer-based text-to-audio. Generates highly realistic multilingual speech, music, sound effects, and non-verbal communications.
tools.notes: Runs on CPU but GPU is much faster. Large model is ~5GB.

tools.name: pyannote-audio
tools.description: Speaker diarization, embedding, and voice activity detection. State-of-the-art on most diarization benchmarks. Used in production by many call-center analytics tools.
tools.notes: Models need user agreement on Hugging Face. Use pyannote/embedding or pyannote/segmentation.

tools.name: Silero Models
tools.description: Pre-trained STT/TTS enterprise-grade models. Compact, fast, multilingual, no GPU required. Great for production deployments.
tools.notes: CPU-friendly, ~100MB models, sub-second inference. English, German, Spanish, French, and Russian. No public HF demo currently — deploy your own.

tools.name: GPT-SoVITS
tools.description: Few-shot voice cloning and TTS. Clone a voice from 5-10 seconds of reference audio, supports Chinese, English, Japanese, and more.
tools.notes: Training and inference both need GPU. ~6GB VRAM minimum for inference. Public demo removed; deploy your own with the command above.

tools.name: Demucs
tools.description: Music source separation. Split any song into vocals, drums, bass, and other stems. Hybrid Transformer-based, SOTA on MUSDB18.
tools.notes: htdemucs (default) is best quality. mdx_extra_q is fastest.

tools.name: MeloTTS
tools.description: High-quality multilingual TTS from MyShell AI. English (American/British/Indian), Spanish, French, Chinese, Japanese, Korean — all in one model.
tools.notes: CPU-friendly. ~300MB models. No public HF demo currently — deploy your own.

tools.name: Soft-VC VITS Singing
tools.description: SoftVC VITS singing voice conversion. Convert one singer's voice to another's while preserving melody and (mostly) pronunciation.
tools.notes: Trained models are required (not shipped with the repo). GPU strongly recommended. Public demo removed; deploy your own.

tools.name: Gradio
tools.description: The library itself. Includes a curated set of demo apps covering chat, image, audio, video, and more. Perfect starting point for your own app.
tools.notes: If you want to build your own Gradio app, start here. The repo's guides/ folder has step-by-step recipes. Browse the demo Spaces under huggingface.co/gradio.
